## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or design decision.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Explain any checks not run.

- [ ] `cargo xtask ci`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Meaningful regression coverage for behavior changes, following the TDD contract
- [ ] Affected documentation updated; implemented behavior and planned support distinguished

For documentation-only changes, mark behavior coverage as not applicable.
Do not include credentials or private data in fixtures or logs.
